scope: A bounded ADSCHK frame-boundary diagnostic at the existing selected SPI clock; no GPIO/RMT takeover, no scientific samples, no boot selection changes, no physical experiment performed.

existing_symbol_map.role: Calls the registered runtime query/control callback.
Existing ADSCHK/ADSCHK=N parser, default100, accepted range1..1000; posts request, emits accepted ACK.
Posts SENSORARRAY_COMMAND_ADS_CHECK with value=sampleCount, signedValue=0 and shared requestId.
Stores pending request; returns after one ADS_CHECK to retain mailbox order.
Called after complete sensorarrayRunOneFrame and battery/pending auxiliary work; before the next frame starts.
Acquires OWNER_CHECK, starts1.5s transaction, saves snapshot, STOP/START current profile, WaitDrdyGeneration+RawDmaReady loop, restores snapshot/cache; it is not AA and does not call FreshChecked.
Writes MODE0/MODE1 together, reads back and updates driver mode shadows only on success.
START1 is unconditional, then on SPI return sets adc1Running=true and increments configurationGeneration; configuredDrdyGeneration is sampled only after the transfer returns.
New DRDY generation, stable configurationGeneration, original CRC and NEW_DATA checks; retryBudget=0 gives an unhidden single wire attempt.
STOP, POWER, INTERFACE/MODE0/1/2/INPMUX, OCAL/FSCAL and REFMUX; masked full readback; driver shadow update, notifications clear, reference-ready wait and optional START.
Restores register cache; transaction generation invalidates profile/value caches at next EngineReadFrame, without resetting engine frame count or health interval.

proposed_protocol.new_command: ADSCHK=TIMING,200 or ADSCHK=TIMING,800; new diagnostic extension, old numeric ADSCHK semantics unchanged
proposed_protocol.selection: Four primary groups per request: CONT/PULSE x PGA1/bypass; requested count is per group. 200 is screen,800 is a separate confirmation request. Pair modes by PGA profile; reverse pair order in confirmation to expose order effects.
proposed_protocol.admission: Only known CAP/VOLT route with physical snapshot INTREF=0, VBIAS=1, REFMUX=0x24, STATUS+CRC8 enabled, RESET=0, known ID, START GPIO already low, quiescent owners and no in-flight/quarantined SPI. No GPIO writes. RES/unknown reference state is explicitly unavailable; do not turn INTREF off/on to make this experiment run.
proposed_protocol.physical_state: Require existing VBIAS; never alter POWER, rail calibration, offsets, external row routing, clock rate or duty during the diagnostic. AA selects AINCOM for both ADC differential inputs; it is an internal mux short, not physical matrix isolation.
proposed_protocol.mailbox: Proposed new PostAdsTimingCheck maps existing ADS_CHECK type with value=N and signedValue=diagnosticKind1; old PostAdsCheck stayskind0. Core1 owns the whole bounded operation. MODE/ROWS/ROWMODES remain queued until it finishes.
proposed_protocol.science: No frame builder/encoder/cache/PGA-training calls, no sequence increment and no zero-filled or synthetic science frame. The already completed preceding frame retains its immutable identity and original sample times; it may be emitted later after the diagnostic.
proposed_protocol.terminal: Separate accepted ACK, completed/incomplete terminal, originalError, terminalError and cleanupError; do not use MAPP/RMAPP or imply ADC precision qualification. Retain a bounded result for id-scoped read-only summary/record queries if wire logs drop.

common.crc: Original four-data-byte0x107 CRC, never corrected or masked
common.filter: MODE1 selects SINC1 but at38400SPS the second stage is bypassed; effective first stage SINC5, first conversion nominal207us.

profile.setup: Stop continuous ADC; ConfigureAdc1Mode; SetMode2Verified; SetInputMuxVerified(0xA,0xA); compare entire expected snapshot with masks and reject any snapshotMismatchCount delta. Do not call Configure(), which also writes POWER.

primary_read_algorithm.continuous: START once after profile verification; each read passes current DRDY generation to FreshChecked and retryBudget=0. Continuous mode can produce multiple unconsumed conversions; only verified read attempts count.
pulse_steps: For each attempt, record preStartGeneration and tStartCallUs, then unconditionally call StartAdc1 even if software adc1Running remains true from the prior automatically completed pulse.
After START returns, record tStartReturnUs, configurationGeneration and configuredDrdyGeneration as the start fence. Never rewrite either generation.

Require configuredDrdyGeneration==preStartGeneration. If different, a DRDY edge happened before the software fence; classify start_fence_missed/inconclusive, not CRC, and do not accept the held result as fresh.

Pass the configuredDrdyGeneration fence to FreshChecked, not a new GetDrdyGeneration value taken later. An edge after the fence but before the caller executes remains admissible through the unchanged FreshChecked checks.

Require configurationGeneration unchanged even when FreshChecked returns CRC; require pulse generation delta exactly1 modulouint32. NEW_DATA=1 and no RESET/reference/PGA alarm are required for a CRC-valid primary result.

Use the existing600us DRDY timeout, clipped to the shared work deadline; no retries. Timeout/early fence/extra edges are distinct incomplete timing results, never counted as CRC success or bad data admitted.
After CRC, keep exact rejected bytes in diagnostic evidence only. Verify register health before proceeding; no bad sample updates scientific values, profile cache, gain or valid parity.
primary_read_algorithm.race_proof: ADS START command takes effect on the7th SCLK falling edge. At551kHz the8clock opcode is14.519us versus nominal207us first conversion, but queue/get-result scheduling can return much later. Thus wire duration alone cannot establish the software generation fence.
primary_read_algorithm.notification_semantics: Clearing notifications does not clear hardware freshness. Keep existing DRDY ISR and persistent main task; no task deletion or replacement reader. GPIO-low alone never authorizes a fresh read.
primary_read_algorithm.timestamp_limit: Current report.waitUs/readUs and before/after timestamps are software observation/transaction bounds, not a hardware DRDY edge timestamp; do not label them physical edge timing.

holding_repeat.scope: Optional paired RDATA1 once after every completed pulse primary read; separate held_repeat counters, never primary-attempt denominator.
holding_repeat.driver: RawDmaReady is allowed only for an explicitly diagnostic holding-register reread. It bypasses no scientific gate because its output is never a fresh sample or a frame.
holding_repeat.requirements: No START or config write between primary and repeat; unchanged config+DRDY generation before/after. A CRC-valid repeat must have NEW_DATA=0 and, if primary was CRC-valid, identical raw code. If these fail, report hold_state_changed and stop; do not repair the result.
holding_repeat.meaning: DatasheetFig9-44 says pulse DRDY stays low until the next START, while continuous DRDY goes high on first opcode falling edge. A final-bit error-direction change would support a DOUT tail hypothesis; it would not itself prove the ESP sampling instant or justify bit correction.
holding_repeat.crc: Compare original received CRC against original computed CRC. Both0-to1 and1-to0 counters, xorOther and exact rejected6bytes remain independent of held data equality.

deadline_budget.work_ownership: One CHECK owner spans work and cleanup. BeginTransactionUntil(workEnd=absoluteEnd-500ms); end only the driver work deadline, then BeginTransactionUntil(originalAbsoluteEnd) for cleanup, without releasing the owner or granting a new deadline.
deadline_budget.slowest125k_note: Healthy primary+holding+nominal one-tick-per32 yielding is approximately0.90s for200 and3.63s for800, plus register verification/setup. Proposed1.5s/4.5s work windows provide bounded normal margin; they do not promise completion under CPU starvation or repeated register/SPI errors.
deadline_budget.fairness: One actual vTaskDelay(1) after each32 completed attempts, after pulse holding read and before next START; no watchdog feeding proxy or priority change. Check work deadline before every new hardware operation and after every wait.
deadline_budget.overrun: IDF FreeRTOS waits round up at100Hz, so report deadlineOverrunUs and the one-tick rounding envelope; scheduler starvation is not a hard real-time guarantee. No continuing another sample or creating a fresh budget after expiry.
deadline_budget.crc_rate: Do not stop merely because diagnostic CRC rate exceeds2.5%; collect up to fixed count if state remains verified, then report rate failure. A hard state error or deadline aborts. Repeated-error extra verification may exhaust budget and yields incomplete, never a fabricated complete rate.

restore_chain: Before mutation save full physical snapshot, driver reference/run state, state flags and register-cache evidence. Reject unstable snapshots even if majority reader returns ESP_OK. Distinguish policy rejection unchanged from unknown hardware.

Keep originalError first-wins; terminalError records later hard fault, cleanupError separately first-wins. Quarantine means no further SPI writes/clock changes/descriptor reuse/removal; leave DMA storage persistent and route into existing isolation/recovery.

If pulse was configured and SPI remains usable, first ConfigureAdc1Mode(0x00,0x00) with verified readback. MODE0 is marked ADC1 restart in the datasheet, so the actual40->00 write changes the active conversion mode. Then STOP1 under continuous semantics. A STOP sent while pulse is active is not a cancellation acknowledgement.

Invoke RestoreAdc1RegisterSnapshot(saved,savedVref,savedRunning). It restores physical register values and driver shadows with verified full readback. Check snapshotMismatchCount delta, ID, RESET, masked POWER/INTERFACE/REFMUX and all mode/mux/calibration bytes. No INTREF ON is possible because entry required saved POWER.INTREF=0.

On verified restoration populate register cache, update state running flags, increment check transaction generation, retain route/config identity. Matrix next-entry profile/value cache invalidation and transition-sensitive frame happen through the existing helperGeneration mechanism; engine frame count/health boundary are not reset.

On cleanup failure invalidate caches and require isolation/recovery before any next matrix frame. On an observed RESET or genuine configuration/owner fault, restoration alone does not authorize normal continuation; preserve evidence and hard-fault disposition. Admission-only unsupported mode leaves hardware unchanged and should not masquerade as restore failure.
Release CHECK owner only after cleanup result/evidence is captured. Format/publish diagnostics after hardware locks and owner are released. Retained result queries remain bounded.

bounded_evidence.records: Fixed budget of at most8 records per primary group: representative first good even/odd and first rejected CRC directions, with requestId/group/attempt,software timestamps,generation before/fence/after,configurationGeneration,raw/status validity flags. BadCRC records use existing FreshReadReport.firstCrcFault exact bytes/computed/received/xor; no reconstructed good wire CRC is claimed.
bounded_evidence.transport: Retain bounded last-completed result with request identity; summaries/records may be queried in single bounded replies. Emit only bounded summary/selected records after restore; report evidence truncation/log enqueue failure, do not assume a burst was received.
bounded_evidence.counter_scope: Primary and held-repeat CRC counts are separate. Existing driver counters legitimately include both; log diagnostic counter-start/end so later runtime windows can exclude this interval without resetting/hiding counters.
bounded_evidence.acceptance: Report per-primary-group threshold5/200 or20/800, valid-even/odd coverage and completion separately. Finite AA diagnostic is not precision validation, matrix-load equivalence or a guarantee that runtime CRC will remain below2.5%.

minimal_new_interfaces_not_implemented.purpose: Reuse CHECK owner, save/restore/cache/transaction evidence. New explicit diagnostic result, not reinterpretation of ActiveCheckResult.
Bounded CONT/PULSE profile/sample/holding loops; no matrix APIs or route writes. New file keeps experiment outside matrix engine and boot selection.
Shared ID/order, only200 or800; old ADSCHK unchanged. Separate result kind controls correct admission and hard-fault disposition.

minimal_new_interfaces_not_implemented.api: No sampling-path driver modification required for first implementation
minimal_new_interfaces_not_implemented.purpose: Read existing configuredDrdyGeneration under exclusive CHECK ownership; strict FreshChecked. If races make pulse inconclusive, report it before considering a separately reviewed command-fence API.

minimum_actual_production_regressions_re: Old ADSCHK/N parser and numeric range unchanged; new200/800 accepted, malformed text/unsupported mode rejected without mutation; queued MODE/ROWS/ROWMODES cannot interleave.

First pulse new edge after START fence succeeds; edge between fence assignment and caller resumes also succeeds using configured floor; edge before fence returns start_fence_missed and no sample; no edge times out; wrapFFFFFFFF->0 works.
Driver START queue/get-result delayed beyond207us cannot be counted fresh by elapsed-time assumption; generation/config mismatch on CRC path remains hard; GPIO low/no new edge fails.

CRC is preserved bothdirections, retry=0, no valid/parity/cache update for bad frames; pureCRC above threshold can finish diagnostic while hardRESET/config/status/owner fault aborts even after earlierCRC.
Held repeat has NEW_DATA0, same data and same generations; NEW_DATA1 or generation movement is rejected; bad heldCRC is separate from primary rate; no science frame function is called.

Pulse STOP does not stop simulated conversion; verifiedMODE0->continuous thenSTOP path runs before restore. Inject errors at mode exit,stop,power,interface,mode,mux,calibration,refmux,verify,reference wait and run-state restart; preservefirst/cleanup separately.
Save failure before mutation, INTREF_ON, RESET, unknownGPIO/route, unstableRREG and mismatch generation are accurately unchanged/unknown; no success boolean leads to automatic new frame.
SPI completion timeout retains persistent DMA descriptor/buffer, forbids further configuration/restore and leaves quarantine; mutex/queue timeout with no in-flight work remains distinguishable.

Shared absolute deadline clips all operations; cleanup reserve survives work exhaustion; no duplicate Begin/End ownership leak; tick wrap/rounding bounded; fixed record cap and pathological formatting values fit reply buffers.

Verified restore updates driver/register shadow and invalidates profile/value caches through helperGeneration; preserves boot/config identity, engine frame count, health interval, rail calibration, lastGood timestamps and failure budgets.
